seed_hist = None

        seed_hist = h

import os
import bioblend.galaxy

api_key = open(os.environ["GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE"]).read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

seed_history_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b527339c3af0c7be44"

# Try to copy the history
try:
    result = gi.histories.copy_history(seed_history_id, name="Copy: What is the median patristic distance for the fungal gene 981902at2759?")
    print(f"Copied successfully!")
    print(f"New history ID: {result['id']}")
    print(f"New history name: {result['name']}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"copy_history error: {e}")
    print("\nTrying export/import approach...")
    
    # Try exporting and importing
    try:
        # Export the history
        export_result = gi.histories.export_history(seed_history_id, wait=True)
        print(f"Export result: {export_result}")
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"Export error: {e2}")
    
    print("\nTrying to get most recently used history...")
    try:
        mru = gi.histories.get_most_recently_used_history()
        print(f"MRU: {mru}")
    except Exception as e3:
        print(f"MRU error: {e3}")
    
    # Check if there's a direct Galaxy API endpoint
    print("\nChecking Galaxy API directly...")
    import requests
    url = f"https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{seed_history_id}"
    headers = {"x-api-key": api_key}
    r = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    print(f"GET history: {r.status_code}")
    if r.status_code == 200:
        hdata = r.json()
        print(f"  username: {hdata.get('username')}")
        print(f"  published: {hdata.get('published')}")
        print(f"  importable: {hdata.get('importable')}")
        
        # Try to import it
        import_url = f"https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{seed_history_id}/import"
        r2 = requests.post(import_url, headers=headers)
        print(f"Import result: {r2.status_code} {r2.text[:200]}")
PYEOF

import requests
import os

# Search BioContainers registries for dendropy, biopython, ete3
packages = ["dendropy", "biopython", "ete3"]
for pkg in packages:
    # Check quay.io
    url = f"https://quay.io/api/v1/repository/biocontainers/{pkg}/tag/"
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            data = r.json()
            tags = data.get('tags', [])
            # Get the most recent tags
            recent = sorted([t['name'] for t in tags if 'name' in t], reverse=True)[:5]
            print(f"{pkg}: {recent}")
        else:
            print(f"{pkg}: HTTP {r.status_code}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{pkg}: Error - {e}")
PYEOF
